name: Burning Steppes
_terrain: A 3.3.5 zone Turtle changed in the south-east: Karfang Hold (an orc camp: Karfang, Molk, Darkseer Geshtol, Mistress Katalla), Hateforge Excavation (the Dark Iron dig at the Hateforge Quarry entrance) and the quarry pit itself; elsewhere only NPCs (Morgan's Vigil, Blackrock Pass miners, Draco'dar's Blackwing Guard, Flame Crest). The 3.3.5 zone, its NPCs and quests stay.

merge_region._include_chunks: Azeroth_37_45 chunks 214, 215, 236, 237: Badlands (066) took them from Turtle and stitched their south edge onto the 3.3.5 ground; Karfang Hold now takes the Turtle chunks south of them, so they are taken again (Turtle edge both sides, no 4.8-yd dip along the line).

_merge_region: own=changed: only the Burning Steppes chunks Turtle reshaped or gave a new subzone. reshaped_skip_zones: Badlands, Searing Gorge, Northwind (ported earlier: their shipped tiles are the base), Redridge, Swamp of Sorrows, Blasted Lands, Dun Morogh, Blackrock Mountain. reshaped_take_areas: the Hateforge Quarry pit on the main map (Turtle area 5098, the dungeon's zone; the chunks keep their 3.3.5 area).
_exclude_creatures: Training dummies (Draco'dar). Kazud Fireforged, Geldra Bronzewhiskers and Melus Ironeye (Blackrock Mountain): Turtle's tier-set upgrade system (about 100 quests turning raid tier pieces into Turtle-only items).
_exclude_gameobjects: Gardening Zone Check, Speedy's Jukebox, Survival's Dead Wood Trees, Gemstone Deposits.
_extra_creature_templates: Turtle's dummy credit NPCs for 'Hearing Orvak's Story' (40460) and 'Investigating Hateforge' (40486), given by manual/083.
